secciones: Porsche workshop services
At Valentin we cover the full range of Porsche services and specialist servicing, so that any issue can be resolved in one place.
One of the most requested services at our Madrid facility is Porsche vehicle storage.
We are subscribed to the manufacturer’s official platform, P.P.N. (Porsche Partner Network), which gives us factory information and lets us be precise about how each customer’s car is looked after.
Since 2019 we have been an authorised distributor and installer for the German firm TECHART.

Porsche storage: rather more than a parking space

We understand that a Porsche is not simply a vehicle but an object of value, passion and investment. Our storage service therefore goes well beyond offering somewhere to park it: we provide an environment designed to keep the car in the best possible condition.

The service is intended for owners who need to free up space in their garage, who use their Porsche occasionally, who spend long periods away from home, or who want to keep the car in optimum condition while it is not being driven. Our premises are discreet, secure and monitored 24 hours a day.

Alongside storage we carry out periodic inspections and preventive maintenance, checking the general condition of the car and applying whatever it needs to stay mechanically and cosmetically sound. When you decide to drive your Porsche again, it will be ready.

For €250 per month you get a premium service combining security, preservation and specialist attention, well above a conventional parking space. We also offer an exclusive care protocol, with optional services adapted to each car and each owner.
Independent Porsche workshop in central Barcelona.
Porsche specialists since 1979
Valentin Motors is one of the leading independent Porsche specialists in Spain.

Established in 1979 as a service, sales and restoration specialist, the workshop has grown into a reference point, with premises of more than 1,800 square metres in central Barcelona and 3,000 square metres of full service in Leganés, Madrid.

Beyond workshop and servicing work, we have specialist departments covering projects and restorations, engine and transmission rebuilds, motorsport preparation, track days and a broad catalogue of personalisation with the German firm TECHART.
The sales department has grown over the past two decades and specialises mainly in the 911 range. Our sales team is made up of industry experts with a genuine interest in everything Porsche.

“Having a workshop you can trust is essential: people who help you make the decision, with good professionals and proper diagnostic equipment. There is no point taking unnecessary risks; going to a specialist should always be the serious option.”
— Daniel A.
Fixed-price maintenance plan
We follow the maintenance schedules specified by the manufacturer, using original parts and Porsche procedures.
Engine restoration

Mechanical work, and engines in particular, has been our speciality for forty years.

We restore, rebuild and repair any Porsche engine. We collect engines anywhere in Spain and return them once the work is complete.
We have the machinery and tooling for any restoration or machining work, and a parts-sourcing department when a job calls for it.
Gearboxes

We restore every type of Porsche gearbox, from the earliest 356, 915 and G50 units to the most recent 991 and 992 generations.
We also service and repair automatic gearboxes, which avoids having to buy a new one.
Pre-purchase inspection

If you have found a Porsche you want to buy, we can carry out a full assessment of its condition before the purchase, checking the car as it stands and going through its history. That tells you whether the seller’s description holds up and whether there are hidden problems.

The inspection can be done at our Barcelona workshop or by travelling to the car, in Spain or abroad.

A pre-purchase inspection costs €250 plus VAT.
Technical service across Spain
We offer technical service across Spain, as well as technical consultancy for other workshops.
IMS repair

We have carried out a great many IMS jobs in our workshops, across the whole M96 and M97 engine generation.

We work to fixed prices on IMS work (1988 to 2006 models), for both manual and automatic cars.
Bore scoring repair
We have extensive experience in preventive maintenance, diagnosis and repair of problems arising from bore scoring.
Premium paint and bodywork

Bodywork repair and paint to Porsche specification: original colours under the new paint code system.

Cosmetic treatments to protect the body against corrosion using current methods.

Vehicle preparation including panel gap measurement, removal of trim and ancillary parts, cataloguing and re-chroming of fittings, and so on.
